tier_reason: Raised D to C: the enricher found a first-party number in the repository itself, a comment in gif_lib.c DecodeLZW stating the decoder is 2.5x to 30x faster than giflib (opened via raw.githubusercontent.com), so the claim is no longer snippet-only; no harness, machine, images or giflib version accompany it (lodepng-turbo precedent for a source-comment number at C). The enricher's code reading also found memory-safety bugs on valid inputs, recorded as caveats and shortcomings.

corrections.claimed_speedup: First-party source comment in gif_lib.c (DecodeLZW): 2.5x to 30x faster than giflib, with no harness, machine, test images or giflib version. The author's blocked blog post 'A Big Memory GIF Decoder' (2021-03) is summarised by search snippets as 2x/5x/20x.
corrections.caveats: Number is a source-code comment with no setup. Memory safety from code reading (not run): the frame buffer is W*H+8 rounded up to 64 KiB but 256 root-dictionary bytes are written after W*H, so valid GIFs whose W*H mod 65536 falls in 65281-65528 (for example 300x218) overflow the heap; DecodeLZW ignores iLZWSize and reads past the file buffer; sub-block and extension parsing is unbounded; the LZW code size is unchecked; a file descriptor is closed twice; mallocs are unchecked. Partial drop-in only: DGifOpen is a stub returning NULL, the DGifGet* functions are absent, and six declared functions (GCB helpers, EGifPutExtension, GifFreeSavedImages) are undefined.
